94 ## Fourth search (2026-10-03): the paper John remembers ("calibrating deep networks with hierarchical systems;
95 ## Piaget hierarchies empirically more efficient than linear; a Lorentz hierarchy suggested later")
96 No local paper pairs "Piaget" with a hierarchy geometry. The description matches POINCARÉ (hyperbolic) embeddings:
97 - Nickel & Kiela, "Poincaré Embeddings for Learning Hierarchical Representations", NeurIPS 2017 (arXiv 1705.08039;
98   no local PDF). Summarised in Agentic-Home Geometric Memory report §6 l.219: "in as few as 2–5 dimensions, Poincaré
99   embeddings match or beat 200-dimensional Euclidean embeddings on reconstruction and link prediction over WordNet."
100   Follow-up Nickel & Kiela ICML 2018 switched to the LORENTZ model ("more stable optimization for deeper
101   hierarchies", l.221). Sala et al. ICML 2018: MAP 0.989 in 2 dimensions (l.594). HyperbolicRAG Recall@5 79.0% vs
102   73.4% Euclidean.
103 - His own work cited there (files not on this machine): Variable Selection folder, `hyperbolic_cov_report.docx`
104   (Poincaré-ball covariance with a calibrated link g(d) = 2/(1+e^(αd)) − 1 — likely the "calibrating" memory),
105   `Bayesian Partition Inference — LE, Pruning, Manifolds.pdf` (Bell numbers outgrow the Poincaré ball → variable
106   curvature / product simplex), `Bayesian Partition Search on the Liechty-Ebbes Trie — Survey`.
107 - Lorentz: first in the Geometric Memory report (l.264, l.920 "train in Lorentz, project to Poincaré for display",
108   l.1365); recommended explicitly in `BRAIN-ARCHITECTURE-REVIEW.md` l.81 (likely Gemini); adopted 2026-05-05 as
109   BASE-BRAIN-SPEC v2.0.2 "Knowledge-Linear vs Knowledge-Lorentz".
110 - `docs/plans/PLAN-Update-Planning-Cognition.md` l.8 puts "Linear vs. Poincaré" and "a Piagetan Dream Loop" side by
111   side — the likely origin of the merged name.
112 - The planned empirical test is his own: PLAN-Alpha-Agent-Brain-v2 §P13 "Tournament 1: Alpha-Linear-Cell vs
113   Alpha-Poincaré-Cell" (plan, not a result).
114 Reading: the structure is Poincaré/Lorentz (hyperbolic) geometry; the learning is Piaget (assimilation and
115 accommodation in the sleep loop). "Piaget map" = a hyperbolic knowledge map that a Piagetian sleep loop calibrates.
